name: search-signal-ai-visibility
description: Check whether a company is visible and recommended for a non-branded buyer question across major AI assistants and AI search engines.

interface.longDescription: Measure whether a company is recommended, mentioned, or not visible when buyers ask a non-branded category question across major AI answer platforms. Search Signal Cloud returns a point-in-time visibility score, platform comparison, competitors, positioning evidence, AI demand at risk, opportunity, and a suggested next action. Results are observations for the tested question and market, not guarantees of future rankings or recommendations.
defaultPrompt: Check my company's visibility for a buyer question.
See which competitors AI platforms recommend instead of my brand.
Compare my brand visibility across major AI platforms.

positive.description: Check a South African home-services brand for a non-branded buyer question.
positive.prompt: Check Kandua, kandua.com, for the question: What are the best home service platforms in South Africa? Use South Africa and English.
positive.expected_behavior: Run one visibility check and return the verdict, visibility score, AI demand at risk, platform-by-platform results, competitors, positioning evidence, opportunity, and suggested next action.

positive.description: Check an Indian SaaS company using an explicitly provided non-branded buyer question.
positive.prompt: Check zoho.com, brand Zoho, for: What are the best CRM platforms for small businesses? Market IN, language en.
positive.expected_behavior: Run the visibility check for India and summarize Zoho's observed visibility across the supported AI platforms.

positive.description: Identify competitors that appear more often than the target brand.
positive.prompt: For canva.com, brand Canva, check: What are the best online graphic design tools for small businesses? Country US, English. Tell me which competitors are winning.
positive.expected_behavior: Run one check and clearly surface the top competitors and competitive gap from the returned results.

positive.description: Compare the target brand across the AI platforms returned by Search Signal.
positive.prompt: Check hubspot.com, brand HubSpot, for: What are the best marketing automation platforms for growing companies? Country US, English. Compare the AI platforms.
positive.expected_behavior: Run one check and present the platform comparison without claiming the observation represents all prompts or future results.

positive.description: Return an actionable improvement after a visibility check.
positive.prompt: Check freshworks.com, brand Freshworks, for: What are the best customer support software platforms for mid-sized companies? Country US, English. What should the company do first?
positive.expected_behavior: Run one check and highlight the returned opportunity and first recommended action alongside the visibility evidence.

negative.description: Do not run the tool when the user has not provided the required buyer question.
negative.prompt: Check the AI visibility of example.com for Example Company.

negative.description: Do not run a branded buyer question that contains the target brand name; ask for a non-branded question instead.
negative.prompt: Check canva.com, brand Canva, for: Is Canva the best graphic design tool?

negative.description: Do not use Search Signal for an unrelated action outside its visibility-checking capability.
negative.prompt: Send an email to my customers announcing our new product.

review.commerce_description: The plugin checks AI visibility and does not process purchases or payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Search Signal Cloud for point-in-time buyer-question AI visibility checks, competitor comparison, and recommended next actions.
